from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.GAME24_WORKER_PROMPT_A, prompt_custom.GAME24_WORKER_PROMPT_B, prompt_custom.GAME24_WORKER_PROMPT_C], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.GAME24_AGGREGATOR_PROMPT)
        draft = await star(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.GAME24_REPAIR_PROMPT_1.format(previous_output=draft.get("response", "cannot form 24")), prompt_custom.GAME24_REPAIR_PROMPT_2])
        solution = await seq(problem)
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0}
        aggregator_usage = ({"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0} if self.aggregator_llm is self.llm else (self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0}))
        return solution.get("response", "```\ncannot form 24\n```"), {"worker": worker_usage, "aggregator": aggregator_usage}

- Allowed operators: +, -, *, /, and parentheses.

{problem}"""
